financing.request: Reference interest rate and construction-loan terms for a residential development in Mexico City, Mexico.

rates.item: TIIE de Fondeo a un día (latest available observation found; reference benchmark, not a project quote)
rates.note: Banxico table lists 6.52% annual for TIIE de fondeo a un día on 23 Oct 2026. 28-day TIIE listed at 6.7760% on 22–23 Oct 2026. The table has no observation for 24 Oct. Target rate: 6.50% on 23 Oct 2026.

rates.item: TIIE de Fondeo Compuesta por Adelantado a 28 días plus lender spread; numeric spread not publicly specified in reviewed official terms
rates.note: SHF publishes benchmark-plus-surcharge structure but no numeric spread. Therefore no defensible numeric spread assumption is reported.

rates.item: Maximum financing amount: up to 65% of project value (value-based maximum; not explicitly stated as loan-to-cost)
rates.source_title: Crédito Puente en Pesos; Crédito Puente
rates.note: BBVA and SHF publish a maximum of 65% of project commercial/value. This is not explicitly LTC, so treat as a proxy only; SHF says credit reaches developers through financial entities.

rates.item: Origination / opening fee for developer construction bridge loan
rates.note: Not found in the reviewed official public bridge-loan terms; confirm directly with lender.

rates.item: Minimum presales requirement for developer construction bridge loan
rates.note: Not found in the reviewed official public bridge-loan terms; confirm directly with lender.

lenders: BBVA México — publicly offers Crédito Puente en Pesos; up to 65% of project commercial value; benchmark + financial margin.
Banorte — publicly offers Proyectos Inmobiliarios / bridge financing; page states financing up to 80% of total project value; not identified as LTC.

Sociedad Hipotecaria Federal (SHF) — Crédito Puente line offered to financial entities, with developer loans intermediated; up to 65% project value, up to 48 months; 28-day compounded TIIE funding plus surcharge.
Banco Inmobiliario Mexicano (BIM) — publicly offers syndicated bridge loans, up to 65% project value, up to 20% advance, up to 42 months.
Santander — no public developer bridge-loan product terms located in reviewed searches; public-facing pages found were housing-buyer products.
caveats: Published central-bank observations: TIIE de fondeo 6.52% and target 6.50% as of 23 Oct 2026; 28-day TIIE 6.7760% on 23 Oct 2026. The requested October 24 date falls on a non-business day and the table shows no observation that day.

No public, project-specific lender offer exists in these sources. Spread, origination fee and presale threshold are not established by the reviewed official pages; these require lender underwriting and a direct quote.
Polanco V Sección is a premium residential context, but the public terms found are general housing-development products and may not apply to this specific luxury project or borrower.
SHF’s 65% is a maximum against project value, not a published loan-to-cost ratio.

cost.request: Construction cost benchmarks per m² for high-quality residential build to sell (mid-rise, 8 stories, with underground parking) in Mexico City, Mexico, current year.

benchmarks.item: High-quality mid-rise residential hard construction cost, Polanco V Sección / Mexico City (8 stories, underground parking). No public source located that states a directly applicable cost per m² for this exact typology and quality; numeric cost benchmark not reported.
benchmarks.unit: MXN per m² gross building area
benchmarks.source_title: BIMSA Costos; CMIC/CEICO Catálogo de Costos Directos de Vivienda 2025
benchmarks.note: BIMSA advertises paid access to parametric cost-per-m² models, but public page does not disclose figures. The CMIC/CEICO catalog is presented as a reference for direct housing costs; accessible public listing does not expose applicable cost values. Neither source supports a numeric high-quality 8-story Polanco project rate.

benchmarks.item: Underground parking / basement hard cost per m². No directly applicable published public cost value found.
benchmarks.unit: MXN per m² gross basement area
benchmarks.note: BIMSA lists parking among its parametric project categories, but does not publish numeric model outputs on its public page.

benchmarks.item: Annual construction cost escalation indicator: residential construction price change, Mexico, July 2025–July 2026
benchmarks.source_title: CEICO, Variaciones en el precio de la construcción residencial, agosto 2026 (based on INEGI)
benchmarks.note: National residential construction price inflation reported by CEICO using INEGI data. This is an index change, not a Polanco-specific forecast or project escalation allowance.
No sufficiently supported public benchmark found.
No sufficiently supported percentage benchmark found.

caveats: Benchmarks are not contractor quotations. Publicly accessible material reviewed did not provide a numeric cost-per-m² for the requested high-quality, 8-story Mexico City residential typology with underground parking; do not treat generic house-building rates as equivalent.
CMIC/CEICO reports national residential price movement; its published figure is not a cost level and should not be extrapolated as a Polanco-specific rate without project pricing.
The accessible CMIC/CEICO catalog says its direct-cost catalog is illustrative and based on average working conditions, with project-specific variables affecting results.
